LESSON: TRUST:

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.1: Trust:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Trust:
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you avoid talking to strangers?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify people he/she can trust for own safety
2. recite Psalm 125:1 and trust in God always

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

▸ Skill 2: recite Psalm 125:1 and trust in God always

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.

• Model 1: identify people he/she can trust for own safety

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify people he/she can trust for own safety

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Trust:.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you avoid talking to strangers?
2. Why should you put your trust in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify people he/she can trust for own safety
• recite Psalm 125:1 and trust in God always

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
